composition_subtypes.role: Core algorithm: always sell when price exceeds heap minimum, push twice for residual re-use
Min-heap tracks buy prices and potential re-pairing candidates

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy profit-taking uses a min-heap to find best historical buy price and support re-pairing via double push.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a greedy algorithm that processes prices sequentially, using a priority queue to efficiently track the optimal buy sequences and enable re-pairing of buys and sells for maximum profit.
